SEARCH
Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.runtime

Record Class RuntimeManifest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.runtime.RuntimeManifest
Record Components:
serverType - The server type.
serverVersion - The resolved server version.
paperBuildId - The resolved Paper build id.
cacheKey - The resolved cache key.
serverDirectory - The prepared target server directory.
serverJar - The path to the prepared server jar.
memoryMb - The memory (in MB) allocated to the server runtime.
udsSocketPath - The UDS socket path for agent IPC.
agentAuthToken - The short-lived agent auth token.
agentJar - Optional path to the deployed agent jar.
agentJarSha256 - Optional SHA-256 hash for the agent jar.
runtimeProtocolVersion - The runtime protocol version. Must exactly match RuntimeProtocol.VERSION.
agentCacheIdentity - The cache identity for the resolved agent artifact.
extraJvmArgs - Optional extra JVM arguments that must be applied when launching the test server runtime.
provisionedWorlds - All worlds provisioned into the server directory by prepare-server, including templates that are not loaded on startup. The framework preloads the loadOnStartup entries before test execution and validates template names against the full list.
public record RuntimeManifest(String serverType, String serverVersion, long paperBuildId, String cacheKey, String serverDirectory, String serverJar, int memoryMb, String udsSocketPath, String agentAuthToken, @Nullable String agentJar, @Nullable String agentJarSha256, int runtimeProtocolVersion, String agentCacheIdentity, @Nullable String extraJvmArgs, List<RuntimeManifest.ProvisionedWorld> provisionedWorlds) extends Record
Runtime manifest written by prepare-server.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
